body.name: X
body.def: Let \(G_{ns}(\rho)=\{1,\ldots,N_{n1s}\}\setminus H_{n,s}(\rho)\), \(g^z_{ns}=\sum_{i\in G_{ns}(\rho)}\mathbf 1\{Z_{n1si}=z\}\), \(\bar Y^z_{G,ns}=(g^z_{ns})^{-1}\sum_{i\in G_{ns}(\rho)}\mathbf 1\{Z_{n1si}=z\}Y^{\mathrm{obs},1}_{nsi}\), and \(s^{2,z}_{G,ns}=(g^z_{ns}-1)^{-1}\sum_{i\in G_{ns}(\rho)}\mathbf 1\{Z_{n1si}=z\}(Y^{\mathrm{obs},1}_{nsi}-\bar Y^z_{G,ns})^2\). When \(g^0_{ns},g^1_{ns}\ge2\) and \(\widehat v^X_{ns}=s^{2,1}_{G,ns}/g^1_{ns}+s^{2,0}_{G,ns}/g^0_{ns}>0\), define the uncentered selector \(X_{n,s}(\rho)=(\bar Y^1_{G,ns}-\bar Y^0_{G,ns})/\sqrt{\widehat v^X_{ns}}\); otherwise set \(X_{n,s}(\rho)=c_s-1\), which deterministically means no recruitment.
